findings.fact: quoted_chars counts only escapeFenceText(event.text).length. input_tokens counts complete system+user message UTF-16 length / 4, rounded up, including fence wrappers, headers, predicates, subject JSON and known claims.
findings.tiny_proof: text "hello" is 5 quoted chars and 2112 message chars / 528 estimated tokens.
findings.invariant: A record under 24000 quoted chars can still exhaust max_input_tokens.

findings.fact: Model extraction never slices quoted text. An escaped body over EXTRACT_INPUT_CHARS=24000 becomes budget_exhausted / max_quoted_chars with used=0. planBatches DroppedDraft event_too_large is not returned from produce(); the first oversized record aborts the whole input, including later records that would fit. Diagnostic has no event_id.

Deterministic capture notes clip with text.slice(0, 8000) and insert the sentence " Quoted text truncated to the capture-note budget." into the header. There is no structured truncated boolean on the proposal.
findings.tiny_analog: maxChars=8, "hello world" -> clipped "hello wo", truncated=true, notice present

findings.fact: Subjects beyond maxSubjectsPerEvent=16 are sliced with no truncation notice on capture notes or page candidates. Page-candidate bodies are not clipped to 8000.
findings.existing_test: producers.test.ts:256-265 and page-candidate.test.ts:156-178 assert counts, not a notice

findings.fact: Each <<<KZ- lookalike adds one escaped code unit. A 24000-char raw body containing a lookalike would exceed EXTRACT_INPUT_CHARS after escape. Existing oversized test uses 24001 raw y characters with no lookalike.
Known claims whose subject is absent from the batch event subject map are omitted from the prompt. Serving also caps authorized known claims at 32. Neither path emits a truncation notice.
findings.tiny_proof: c-bob omitted; c-ada kept in known-claims fence
